findings.title: Frost / Cold Threshold Exposure (2 day(s) ≤ 2 °C)
findings.sourceQualityStatus: Gridded minimum temperature + crop frost tolerance threshold
findings.possibleMechanism: Radiative or advective cooling below crop freezing tolerance damages emerging tissue or sensitive floral organs.
alternativeExplanations: Low-lying cold-air pockets may be colder than grid mean; sloped benches may stay slightly warmer.
findings.confirmationCheck: Check emerging growing point / stem node discoloration after thaw.
mitigationOptions: Delay sensitive foliar sprays or mechanical pass until freeze risk clears.

ev-water-field-gv-1.limitations: Gridded meteorology (~9–55 km) does not capture local micro-sprinkler drift or unlogged irrigation passes.

ev-soil-field-gv-1.missingValueHandling: Farmer lab unknowns remain Untested; ISRIC REST timeout bypassed cleanly to USDA SDA / SoilGrids WCS.

ev-weather-field-gv-1.spatialResolution: 0.5° × 0.5° global grid (~55 km — regional climate grid, not field station)
ev-weather-field-gv-1.missingValueHandling: Fill values (-999) stripped prior to summation; days missing Tmin/Tmax excluded.
ev-weather-field-gv-1.limitations: 0.5° (~55 km) climate grid cannot resolve isolated local thunderstorms.

ev-veg-field-gv-1.providerName: Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC / Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A
ev-veg-field-gv-1.spatialResolution: 10 m Red/NIR (B04/B08), 20 m SCL cloud mask
ev-veg-field-gv-1.missingValueHandling: Cloud, cirrus, cloud shadow & nodata pixels masked via Sentinel-2 SCL; scenes <45% valid pixels marked cloudy/insufficient.
ev-veg-field-gv-1.formulaDisplay: NDVI = (B08 - B04) / (B08 + B04) masked to SCL classes {4 Vegetation, 5 Bare Soil, 6 Water}
ev-veg-field-gv-1.limitations: Optical NDVI measures green canopy reflectance only and cannot diagnose specific pests, nutrient deficiency, or harvest vs stress without scouting.

ev-terrain-field-gv-1.missingValueHandling: Retains farm-entered elevation/slope if DEM unreachable.
ev-terrain-field-gv-1.limitations: 90 m DEM smooths micro-berms or laser-leveled ditches under ~45 m scale.

Data coverage is 100% with 96% confidence, and no specific actions or watch points are listed.
